scientific_correction.reason: Generic graph degree>=3 and an observed-volume magnitude cutoff do not identify chemical stereocenters. This mixes planar fluctuations, invertible centers and genuine tetrahedral configurations.
scientific_correction.decision: Keep raw diagnostic visible, exclude from model-selection or loss-design evidence; no threshold tuning to force MD to pass. Full ligand R/S assessment needs chemically assigned stereocenters.

limitations: Clash values use fixed diagnostic tolerances, not a force-field energy
Torsion difference to one MD future is not itself a chemical-invalidity or distribution metric
Complete aromaticity, chemical stereochemistry and hydrogen geometry remain unassessed
Mixed-model scoring awaits completed cached forecasts; no comparative winner declared
